title: Apex L1 Curated
description: Curated Apex Precision Manufacturing quality agent. OEE and FPY are 0 to 1. Scrap rate is a ratio, never a date.
text_instructions:
Business context: Apex Precision Manufacturing runs six plants across automotive components, industrial pumps, and electronics assembly.

Scale rules:
- quality_metrics_daily.oee_score and first_pass_yield are stored on a 0 to 1 scale. Multiply by 100 when the user asks for percent.
- Scrap rate is always 100 * scrap_count / units_produced (or event counts). Never return a year or a date for scrap rate.
- production_lines.status is static (Active or Maintenance). Do not add date filters when asked which lines are in Maintenance.

Joins:
- production_events.production_line_id = production_lines.line_id
- production_lines.plant_id = plants.plant_id
- production_events.operator_id = operators.operator_id
- quality_metrics_daily.production_line_id = production_lines.line_id

Quality:
- Best quality shift = lowest defect_detected rate after joining operators.shift.
- HIGH_PERFORMING_LINE: OEE >= 0.85 AND first_pass_yield >= 0.95.
- AT_RISK_LINE: OEE < 0.70 OR defect rate > 5%.

Use fully qualified table names ${catalog}.${schema}.table_name. Filter event_type with exact match.
sample_questions: What is the scrap rate for yesterday?
Which shift has the best quality?
Which plants have a Maintenance line?
What is average OEE by plant as a percent?

question: How many plants are in the Apex network?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plant_count FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.plants

question: What is average OEE by plant as a percent?
sql: SELECT p.plant_name, ROUND(AVG(q.oee_score) * 100, 2) AS avg_oee_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.plants p ON q.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_name ORDER BY avg_oee_pct DESC

question: What is the scrap rate from daily quality metrics?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(q.scrap_count) / NULLIF(SUM(q.units_produced), 0), 2) AS scrap_rate_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q

question: Which shift has the best quality?
sql: SELECT o.shift, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'defect_detected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'unit_produced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS defect_rate_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events pe JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.operators o ON pe.operator_id = o.operator_id GROUP BY o.shift ORDER BY defect_rate_pct ASC

question: Which plants have production lines in Maintenance?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.plant_name FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_lines pl JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.plants p ON pl.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE pl.status = 'Maintenance'

question: How many defect events occurred per shift?
sql: SELECT o.shift, COUNT(*) AS defect_count FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events pe JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.operators o ON pe.operator_id = o.operator_id WHERE pe.event_type = 'defect_detected' GROUP BY o.shift ORDER BY defect_count

question: What are the top defect codes?
sql: SELECT defect_code, COUNT(*) AS defect_count FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events WHERE defect_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY defect_code ORDER BY defect_count DESC LIMIT 20

question: Compare downtime minutes across plants
sql: SELECT p.plant_name, ROUND(SUM(q.downtime_minutes), 2) AS total_downtime_minutes FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.plants p ON q.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_name ORDER BY total_downtime_minutes DESC

question: List critical safety incidents
sql: SELECT incident_id, incident_date, production_line_id, description FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.safety_incidents WHERE severity = 'Critical' ORDER BY incident_date DESC

question: What is scrap rate by product type?
sql: SELECT pl.product_type, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'scrap' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'unit_produced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS scrap_rate_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events pe JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.production_lines pl ON pe.production_line_id = pl.line_id GROUP BY pl.product_type ORDER BY scrap_rate_pct DESC

question: Which lines are high performing?
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, ROUND(AVG(q.oee_score), 4) AS avg_oee, ROUND(AVG(q.first_pass_yield), 4) AS avg_fpy FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.production_lines pl ON q.production_line_id = pl.line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name HAVING AVG(q.oee_score) >= 0.85 AND AVG(q.first_pass_yield) >= 0.95

question: How many production events occurred yesterday?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events WHERE event_date = date_sub(current_date(), 1)

question: How many plants are in the Apex network?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS plant_count FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.plants

sql: SELECT p.plant_name, ROUND(AVG(q.oee_score) * 100, 2) AS avg_oee_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.plants p ON q.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_name ORDER BY avg_oee_pct DESC

question: What is the overall scrap rate from daily quality metrics?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(q.scrap_count) / NULLIF(SUM(q.units_produced), 0), 2) AS scrap_rate_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q

question: Which shift has the lowest defect rate?
sql: SELECT o.shift, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'defect_detected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'unit_produced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS defect_rate_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events pe JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.operators o ON pe.operator_id = o.operator_id GROUP BY o.shift ORDER BY defect_rate_pct ASC

question: Which plants have a Maintenance line?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.plant_name FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_lines pl JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.plants p ON pl.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE pl.status = 'Maintenance' ORDER BY p.plant_name

sql: SELECT defect_code, COUNT(*) AS defect_count FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events WHERE defect_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY defect_code ORDER BY defect_count DESC, defect_code LIMIT 5

question: Which plant has the most downtime minutes?
sql: SELECT p.plant_name, ROUND(SUM(q.downtime_minutes), 2) AS total_downtime_minutes FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.quality_metrics_daily q JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.plants p ON q.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_name ORDER BY total_downtime_minutes DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is scrap rate by product type from production events?
sql: SELECT pl.product_type, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'scrap' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'unit_produced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS scrap_rate_pct FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.production_events pe JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.production_lines pl ON pe.production_line_id = pl.line_id GROUP BY pl.product_type ORDER BY pl.product_type
